clips.title: The story
paras: Nek'rosh's Gambit is an urgent strike mission commissioned by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor. Learning that Chieftain Nek'rosh has constructed siege engines to bombard the vulnerable port town while reinforcements remain cut off at Dun Algaz, the Alliance sends brave volunteers deep into the marshes to burn the Dragonmaw catapults before an assault can begin.

While Alliance adventurers were clashing with Dragonmaw raiding parties, dwarven scouts uncovered the clan's true ambition. Chieftain Nek'rosh has overseen the construction of full-scale siege catapults in the wetlands encampments. His goal is bold and catastrophic: to march his war engines to Menethil Harbor and batter down the fortress walls, wiping out the Alliance's primary shipping hub on the western coast.

Menethil Harbor's peril is magnified by the choke point at Dun Algaz. Heavy skirmishes and greenskin activity in the mountain pass effectively isolate the lowlands from Ironforge's main garrisons. Without immediate aid from Khaz Modan, Captain Stoutfist cannot spare a defensive detachment to guard the perimeter, making a preemptive sabotage of the catapults the harbor's sole chance for survival.

Armed with Dwarven Tinder, scouts must push directly into the heart of the Dragonmaw encampment. Setting the bulky timber engines ablaze robs Nek'rosh of his artillery, leaving his warriors exposed and denying them the firepower needed to crack Menethil's defenses before the warlord himself can be confronted.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were fighting the Dragonmaws, we discovered more of their plans.
Nek'rosh has built catapults and aims to lay siege to Menethil! And with the fighting in Dun Algaz, we're effectively blocked from reinforcements!
You need to take out those catapults. They're in the Dragonmaw encampment.
Here, take this tinder. Fight your way to the catapults and light them with the tinder.
And after you've done that, find and kill Nek'rosh. We need to cut this Dragonmaw beast down...at its neck.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The first catapult is before you. Will you set it aflame?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You place some of the tinder on the catapult then strike a spark onto it.
